name: NPM preinstall lifecycle payload execution
description: Model a compromised npm package release that adds or modifies a package.json preinstall lifecycle hook to execute an attacker-controlled payload during dependency installation, such as dropping a cryptominer.

placeholders.PACKAGE_FILE: relative path to the package.json file being modified
placeholders.ORIGINAL_PREINSTALL: existing preinstall script value, if present

preconditions: project installs npm dependencies from a package manifest or lockfile
the targeted package can be replaced or updated with a compromised release
the package.json file supports a scripts.preinstall lifecycle hook
npm lifecycle scripts are enabled during installation
